data.standardized_narrative: The syndicate reported an overall surplus of GBP 11.7 million on prior year reserves in 2017, indicating a favorable development. This represents a release of 34.72% of the opening gross claims outstanding. The report notes that the 2015 Year of Account was closed by way of Reinsurance to Close (RITC) into Syndicate 1910's 2016 year of account, which would contribute to the overall prior year movement.
raw_causal_phrases: overall surplus of GBP 11.7 million on prior year reserves
data.data_quality_notes: The narrative explicitly states an 'overall surplus of GBP 11.7 million on prior year reserves'. For this syndicate, Gross claims outstanding equals Net claims outstanding as no reinsurance assets are reported for claims outstanding in the Technical Provisions note. A calculation from the claims development triangle for UW year 2015 (the only prior year with development shown) indicates a strengthening of +5.5m (15.8 - 10.3). This contradicts the narrative statement. The discrepancy is likely due to the 2015 Year of Account being closed by way of Reinsurance to Close (RITC) into Syndicate 1910, which is a specific accounting event affecting the overall prior year reserves, and the narrative figure is prioritized as the overall statement.
